LESSON: FRIENDSHIP FORMATION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.1: Friendship Formation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Friendship Formation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Friendship Formation
2. Practise Friendship Formation at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Friendship Formation

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Friendship Formation
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Friendship Formation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Friendship Formation at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Friendship Formation at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Friendship Formation
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Friendship Formation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Friendship Formation using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Friendship Formation in the examples.
2. Explain Friendship Formation to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Friendship Formation.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Friendship Formation using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Friendship Formation important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Friendship Formation
2. Practise Friendship Formation at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Friendship Formation

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
